name: smwmusic-l-i-m-e
title: L i m e
description:
Song consisting of 3 interlinked parts with shifting moods.
(contrapuntal, fragmented, afro-cuban)

The beginning sounds more mysterious (ruins/forest-ish) but later on it could suggest a rather intense and dark setting.

If someone is interested, I can make versions with only certain parts of this song or no percussion.

The beginning is also suited for overworlds.
